event.distribution_pattern: Distributed in AR, GA, KY, MO, OK, and TX.

products.product_description: Great Value Old Fashioned Glazed Donuts packaged in a paperboard box with cellophane window and each box contains 6 donuts. Net Wt. per box: 12 oz. (340 g). UPC on retail box: 0 78742 30711 4. DISTRIBUTED BY: Walmart Inc., Bentonville, AR 72716. Each master case contains 9/12 oz. boxes of Great Value Old Fashioned Glazed Donuts.
products.code_info: Lot code on retail box: FLA 19206. Expiration date on master case: 7/25/2020. ***FLA means Franz Los Angeles producing bakery. 19206 means year 2019 and production date of July 25, 2019. ***Expiration date is 365 days from production date.
products.reason_for_recall: Great Value Old Fashioned Glazed Donuts are recalled because packaging glue inside the box was found.
